_comment: Same app, but with the narration engine loaded from .env (#7).
This carries no key: .env is gitignored and holds your own, and the
point of sourcing it here is that the key never has to live in this
file, which is committed. Bind stays on 127.0.0.1 -- a running
RoamWise has no login, so anyone who can reach it spends your quota.
configurations.name: roamwise-nvidia
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; exec venv/bin/streamlit run roamwise/app.py --server.port 8503 --server.headless true --server.address 127.0.0.1
